text:
mira: quick idea \u2014 run a tiny PLG stitch-up for the seed cohort next week. combine gated webinar invites + 25 credits + a 3-prompt starter pack. track per-route activation and CVR by utm.
cal: sounds good. whats the hypothesis/metric? :thinking_face:
mira: hypothesis: gated webinar + tiny credit boost + tailored prompt pack will increase 7-day activation by 8-12% vs control. metric = % who go from signup -> first 3 generation events within 7 days.
josh: do we have capacity for the webinar? i can host a 30m office-hours style on wed 4/24 if that works.
mira: wed 4/24 works. plan: 1) email + in-app banner with gated RSVP 2) assign 25 starter credits on attendance 3) send prompt pack (3 short templates) after RSVP + nudge for first run 24h later.
samir: routing q \u2014 how are we segmenting seed cohort? by signup date last 30d + usage=0? also want to exclude paid trials.
mira: yes segment = signup in last 30d, usage=0, not on trial. Cal \u2014 can you make the segment and export for ad hoc QA by EOD tmrw?
cal: on it. will drop csv in marketing drive and share link here.
onboard-bot: reminder: workflow "credit_assignment_v2" requires approval before cohort write. ping @cal for approval step.
josh: for tracking, use these params: ?utm_source=seed-stitchup&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=seed-stitchup_apr24
mira: good. also add a hidden query param route=promptpack to identify in-app banner clicks.
samir: what about control group? split 70/30? or smaller holdback?
mira: 70/30 control:exposed. need ~1.2k users total for power. will compute exact n tomorrow.
cal: here\u2019s the draft CTA copy for banner: "Join a short intro to Redwood Inference \u2014 get 25 free starter credits & prompt templates to ship faster." thoughts?
josh: love it. shorter variant: "Get 25 starter credits + 3 prompts \u2014 join our 30m webinar."
mira: nice. can we A/B test the short vs long copy on the banner only? keep email copy consistent.
cal: yep. will set AB in banner with 50/50 split among exposed.
samir: QA checklist: segment export, approval for credit workflow, webinar RSVP page with utm+route tagging, prompt pack download, post-attendance credit grant logic, and analytics dashboard (funnel: rsvp->attend->first-run).
mira: assigning tasks: cal = segment + banner AB + export; josh = host + RSVP page + webinar deck; samir = analytics + dashboard; i'll own prompt templates + copy + credit flow approval.
onboard-bot: calendar event created: "Seed Stitchup: Webinar + Starter Credits" Wed Apr 24 16:00. Join link in event.
cal: shared csv + draft banner configs in drive: https://drive.redwood.example/seed-stitchup (please check perms)
josh: i'll draft the deck and share by tues EOD.
mira: awesome. final ask \u2014 keep prompts simple: 1) summarize a transcript 2) few-shot rewrite for tone 3) product-idea brainstorm. 3 lines each.
cal: noted. i'll spin up the AB banner tomorrow morning and loop in infra if needed.
samir: I'll build the dashboard and set alert on early funnel drop-off.
mira: perfect. meeting to sync tues 11am to confirm go/no-go. thanks team :rocket:
